body:
## 💿 The PC that Never Died (But Left its Dust)

This mod is a bizarre, comedy-focused not-so-tech mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 (NeoForge) dedicated to immortalizing the *truly* cursed PC setup. Inspired by the legendary **HP ProDesk "Apple Crapple Precision"** that finally bit the dust, this mod is what happens when that machine’s physical components transcend their mortal coil and become **Minecraft's newest (and dustiest) dimension.**


### 💨 The Dust Dimension: A Realm of PC Remnants

Get ready to traverse the most depressing, yet oddly serene, afterlife of a computer!

* **Dust Dimension:** A new realm linkable through the **Pale Garden** biome. It’s the source of all the dusty, corrupted energy in the mod.
* **Dusty Biome:** A foggy, grayish-toned world where the air is thick with the remnants of failed hard drives and corrupted data.
* **Dusty Ore & Dust Block:** The fundamental resource of this new, cursed land.
* **The Screen Block:** Mining this block is a noisy event! It drops monitors and plays the jarring SFX, **"Airdrop Noises."**


<details>
<summary>🖥️ The Cursed Hardware: Tools and Items SPOILERS
</summary>


I've pulled the most important relics from the PC graveyard and turned them into powerful—and highly suspicious—items:

* **Apple Crapple™ & Apple Crapple V2:** The legendary multi-tools. The V2 version packs a punch with an intentionally over-the-top damage value of **2025**!
* **The Mutitool:** A true jack-of-all-trades, just don't ask what exactly it was used for.
* **Screen Shield & VGA Cable:** Essential protective gear and components for a truly retro experience.
* **Dust Bucket:** Collect the remnants of your digital life—you’re going to need a lot of it.
* **Pluggive:** An item whose purpose is best left unknown, but it’s definitely *pluggive*.

</details>


### 🏆 Advancements & The Troll Feature

Prove your mastery over the cursed hardware by unlocking ridiculous achievements:

* **"How did u do that?"** and **"Forked it!"**
* **"Corrupted"** and **"What a Deal!"** (Look out for the classic **ChatGPT Easter Egg** text in the description of this one!)
* **Legacy Troll:** The **DoNotAirdrop** Gamerule exists purely for legacy, meme-based troll purposes. It does absolutely nothing, but it exists—just like some features in that old PC.

**Get ready to install this mod, embrace the dust, and finally give your old, croaked PC the Minecraft tribute it deserves!**
